solutions.title: Memoized search
solutions.strategy: Recursively subtract each number from the remaining target and cache counts by remainder.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each remainder evaluates all n numbers once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Memoization and recursion stack store target-sized state.

solutions.title: Bottom-up DP
solutions.strategy: For each total from 1 through target, sum the counts of totals that can precede every chosen number.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The DP array stores one count per total.
